b'# tinydl

A tiny downloader that fetches a URL and writes the raw response to a file or stdout.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## CLI Options

| Option | Help |
|--------|------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o, --output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -o output.zip
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip --quiet
```
'
